usage.callShape: GET https://stableanalytics.dev/api/site/overview?site_id={site_id}&period={period}&limit={limit} with Sign-In-With-X: base64(JSON payload) header
usage.outputShape: body.site_id, body.period, body.totals.{visits, unique_ips_estimate}, body.series[].{date, visits}. Other endpoints: /sources → {referrers, utm_sources, utm_campaigns}; /pages → {rows[].{pathname, visits}}; /visits → {rows[].{timestamp, pathname, referrer, utm_source, browser, os, device, country, ip_prefix}}; /tech → {browsers, os, devices, countries}
quirks: Nonce in the 402 SIWX challenge is single-use — must re-probe for a fresh 402 challenge before every new authenticated request
The uri field in the Sign-In-With-X JSON payload must exactly match the full request URL including query string (e.g. https://stableanalytics.dev/api/site/overview?site_id=example.com)
Use issuedAt from the SIWE tool output, not from the 402 challenge — the signer sets this timestamp
chainId in the JSON payload must be the eip155 string form (e.g. 'eip155:8453'), not the numeric integer
Untracked domains return {success:false, error:'Site not found'} with HTTP 404 (NOT 200 as previously documented) — not an auth failure
accepts[] in the 402 challenge body is empty — this is identity-only (SIWX), no payment required
usage.guide: StableAnalytics is a SIWX-only (free, identity-gated) web analytics API with five endpoints. Before each call, probe the target URL with a plain GET to receive a fresh 402 challenge body; extract extensions['sign-in-with-x'].info for domain, uri, version, chainId, type, nonce, issuedAt, expirationTime, and statement. Generate a SIWE signature via mcp__sponge__generate_siwe using those exact values (chain_id: 8453). Construct the JSON payload: {domain, address, statement, uri, version, chainId (as 'eip155:8453'), type ('eip191'), nonce, issuedAt (from SIWE tool), expirationTime, signature}. Base64-encode JSON.stringify(payload) and pass it as the Sign-In-With-X request header. Required query param: site_id (the domain to query). Optional: period (24h|7d|30d, default 7d) and limit (1-500, default 100). Cost is always $0 — SIWX is identity-only.
